PHYS-CL-001.description: Two-body gravitational problem: elliptical orbits. T^2 proportional to a^3. Conserved Runge-Lenz vector gives closed orbits.
PHYS-CL-001.name: Kepler Orbits

PHYS-CL-002.description: Gravitational three-body dynamics. No general closed-form solution. Chaotic trajectories, sensitive dependence on initial conditions.
PHYS-CL-002.name: Three-Body Problem

PHYS-CL-003.description: Strange attractor, butterfly effect, positive Lyapunov exponent. Paradigm of deterministic chaos.
PHYS-CL-003.name: Chaos / Lorenz System

PHYS-CRYSTAL-001.description: Body-centered cubic (coord-8) to face-centered cubic (coord-12) transition under pressure/temperature. BCC sqrt(2)-neighbor geometry is brittle under shear; FCC/HCP hexagonal-close-packed geometry is robust. The sqrt(2)/sqrt(3) ratio distinguishes brittle from stable lattice geometry. Bain path is the minimal-energy transformation path.
PHYS-CRYSTAL-001.name: BCC-FCC Crystal Phase Transition

PHYS-F-001.description: Universal gravitational attraction F = GMm/r^2. Long-range 1/r^2 law.
PHYS-F-001.name: Gravity (Newtonian)

PHYS-KVN-001.description: Unitary lift of Hamiltonian flow to L^2(M, mu). Fills the central void of the physics ring in TF-IDF embedding.
PHYS-KVN-001.name: Koopman-von Neumann Operator

PHYS-PRIMON-001.description: Non-interacting Bose gas with one mode per prime p and single-primon energy E_p = log p. Z(beta) = zeta(beta). Hagedorn transition at beta=1. Ref: Julia, Les Houches 1990.
PHYS-PRIMON-001.name: Julia Primon Gas

PHYS-PT-001.description: Logarithmic capacity of a set E in the complex plane: cap(E) = exp(-V_E) where V_E is the Robin constant. Governs polynomial approximation, conformal mapping, equilibrium measures. Chebyshev constant = cap(E) for intervals. Direct connection to extremal polynomial problems (#1038, Chebyshev sublevel sets) and potential-theoretic Erdos problems (#671). The bridge between complex analysis and combinatorics via equilibrium measure.
PHYS-PT-001.name: Logarithmic Capacity

PHYS-Q-001.description: Core QM principle. System in linear combination of eigenstates until measured. Interference effects.
PHYS-Q-001.name: Quantum Superposition

PHYS-R-002.description: Pendulum demonstrating Earth rotation via precession. Period = 24h/sin(latitude). Slow modulation of fast oscillation.
PHYS-R-002.name: Foucault Pendulum

PHYS-RADAR-001.description: Frequency-hopping patterns with bounded pulse-pair collisions. Side-lobe suppression from B_h[g] constraint. Ambiguity function framework.
PHYS-RADAR-001.name: Frequency-Hopping Radar Codes

PHYS-RMT-001.description: Spectral-radius envelope sigma_MP = epsilon*sqrt(W) of the noisy Ulam-Galerkin operator. Crossover matched to the gap 1 - tau*. Previously labeled GUE Random Matrix Ensemble; refined after EXP-DISS-KVN-001.
PHYS-RMT-001.name: Marchenko-Pastur Spectral Envelope

PHYS-RMT-GUE-001.description: N x N Hermitian random matrices with complex Gaussian entries. Wigner surmise spacing. Connected to Riemann zeros via Montgomery-Odlyzko. Ref: Dyson 1962, Mehta 3rd ed.
PHYS-RMT-GUE-001.name: Gaussian Unitary Ensemble (GUE)

PHYS-SIG-001.description: Pulse timing positions forming a Sidon set guarantee unambiguous radar: no two range-velocity pairs produce the same return. Uniquely decodable sum-channel code. Max density Sidon set = max radar pulses per bandwidth. Singer construction achieves channel capacity ~sqrt(N). Physics: information channel capacity. Math: Sidon set density conjecture h(N)~sqrt(N).
PHYS-SIG-001.name: Radar Ambiguity / Sidon Codes

PHYS-SP-001.description: Gap between smallest eigenvalue (0) and second-smallest (lambda_2) of graph Laplacian. Governs mixing time of random walks, connectivity, expanders. Fiedler value. Cheeger inequality: h^2/2 <= lambda_2 <= 2h. Direct math-physics bridge: same spectral gap appears in quantum Hamiltonians (ground state vs first excited), random matrix theory, and Erdos spectral graph problems (#89 cluster).
PHYS-SP-001.name: Spectral Gap (Laplacian)

PHYS-SPIN-002.description: 1D frustrated Ising-like chain with 3-body interaction J(s_a + s_b - s_{a+b}). Ground-state degeneracy 2^{N/2} matches sum-free count.
PHYS-SPIN-002.name: Frustrated Ising Chain (3-body)

PHYS-T-001.description: Ideal heat engine. Maximum efficiency eta=1-T_cold/T_hot. Reversible limit of thermodynamics.
PHYS-T-001.name: Carnot Cycle

PHYS-T-003.description: Universal behavior near second-order transitions. Power-law scaling, critical exponents. RG theory, universality classes.
PHYS-T-003.name: Critical Phenomena

PHYS-T-005.description: Diffusionless solid-state phase transition: BCC->FCC/BCT via Bain correspondence. sqrt(2) contraction along one axis, sqrt(2) expansion transversely. Square geometry is metastable (zero off-axis slack); hexagonal geometry stable. Mechanism: coord-4 lattice has no slack under shear. Same geometric mechanism as square-packing brittleness in math.
PHYS-T-005.name: Martensitic Transformation
